# Reuse review

1. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/AdminSessionRail.tsx` (renderNode, ~line 39-48) and `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/AllSessions.tsx` (renderNode, ~line 35-46)
   - Summary: both introduce the same JSX block: `<RailNode look={look}>` with the check icon when `look === "done"` and the `star` icon (`size={26} className="fill-current max-[600px]:size-5"`) when `look === "live"`. The `star` icon markup and its class string are copied verbatim.
   - Cost: a change to the rail node icons (size, class, new look) has to be made in two places. `rail-look.ts` was extracted for the look, but the rendering of that look was not.
   - Fix: add one component, for example `RailLookNode({ look })`, next to `RailNode.tsx` (or render the icons inside `RailNode` from `look`) and use it in both rails.

2. `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/FeaturedQuestions.tsx` (lines ~20-70) and `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/StudentQuestions.tsx`
   - Summary: `FeaturedQuestions` repeats the structure of `StudentQuestions`: `useQuestions`, `toSorted((a, b) => b.votes - a.votes)`, `QuestionForm`, a `SkeletonOf` with `QuestionList` over `questionExamples` and a read-only `VoteToggle`, then `QuestionList` with `VoteToggle` and `DeleteOwnQuestion` for `question.mine`. Only the folding (top 3 plus own) and the header are new.
   - Cost: the vote sort, the skeleton and the row renderers exist twice and must change together.
   - Fix: extract a shared piece (for example a `useSortedQuestions` hook plus the skeleton and the row renderers, or let `StudentQuestions` accept an optional `filter` and `header`) and have `FeaturedQuestions` supply only the folding and the toggle.

3. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/EnableSessionDialog.tsx` (lines ~33-42), `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/EnabledSwitch.tsx` (lines ~24-36), `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/FeaturedSwitch.tsx` (lines ~19-32) and `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/FeaturedQuestionsSwitch.tsx` (lines ~21-40)
   - Summary: the diff adds four more hand-written `<button role="switch" aria-checked ...>` + `<Switch on />` blocks, with a near-identical layout (`flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm`, a label span, the knob). `ThemeSwitch`, `UserRow` and `UploadMaterialDialog` already do the same in the base, so the repeat count grows from 3 to 7.
   - Cost: the role/aria/label/knob wiring is repeated in each file; `EnabledSwitch` and `FeaturedSwitch` even differ only in `mt-4` vs `mt-3`.
   - Fix: add a `LabeledSwitch` (label, `on`, `disabled`, `onClick`, `className`) in `ui/` and use it in the new switches (at least within the four files this diff touches).

4. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/FeaturedSwitch.tsx` (lines ~33-72)
   - Summary: the two `ConfirmAction` branches (un-feature and feature-over-another) and the third `toggle` branch repeat the same props (`renderTrigger`, `confirmIcon={null}`, `errorText`, `pendingLabel`, `onConfirm` with `update.mutateAsync({ id, change: { featured } })`); the three conditions are also mutually exclusive cases of one decision.
   - Cost: three render branches for one switch, each carrying the same `update.mutateAsync` call shape.
   - Fix: compute the confirmation once (title, text, content, label, target `featured` value, or none) and render a single `ConfirmAction` or the plain toggle.

5. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/FeaturedEffects.tsx` (line ~12, `countLabel`) and `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/FeaturedQuestions.tsx` (line ~19, `countLabel`), against `app/apps/web/src/features/polls/poll-meta.ts` (`answers`)
   - Summary: two new local singular/plural helpers with the same `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}` body, and a third copy already in the base (`answers`). The two new ones also share the name `countLabel` with different signatures.
   - Cost: the same pluralization is implemented in three places.
   - Fix: add one shared helper (for example `ui/plural.ts`: `plural(count, one, many)`), and build `answers` and both `countLabel`s on it.

6. `app/apps/web/src/features/polls/AdminPanelPolls.tsx` (the `isFeatured || !current.some(draft) ? null : <NotFeaturedNote />` line) and `app/apps/web/src/features/polls/AdminPollsTab.tsx` (`noteAfter` / `Fragment` logic)
   - Summary: both decide when to show `NotFeaturedNote` (not featured and there is a draft) with separate expressions, and `isFeatured` is threaded through `AdminPollsTab` → `AdminPollCard` → `PollActions` → `PollStateActions` and `AdminPanelPolls` → `PanelPollCard` → `PollStateActions`, with each level re-declaring the prop.
   - Cost: the "can activate" rule lives in the prop chain and in two note conditions; a new place that shows polls must repeat it.
   - Fix: derive the featured state where it is used (for example `PollStateActions` reading `useFeaturedSession`/the session query) or pass one `canActivate` already combined with `isFeatured`, and share a `hasDraft(polls)` check for the note.

7. `app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/index.tsx`, `app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/aula.tsx` and `app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/admin/index.tsx`
   - Summary: each route repeats `sessions.data?.find((session) => session.featured)` (lines: index.tsx `featured`, aula.tsx `featured`, admin/index.tsx `all.find((session) => session.featured)`). The diff adds `useFeaturedSession.ts` with a `findFeatured` selector, but it only runs on the admin query and is used by `ContentTab` only.
   - Cost: the "which session is featured" rule is spelled out four times.
   - Fix: export `findFeatured` (or a `useSessions`-based `useFeaturedStudentSession`) from `useFeaturedSession.ts` and use it in the three routes.
EOF
